description: Schema for creating a new inactive VEN cleanup schedule. Define a schedule that will automatically remove VEN workloads that have been inactive for a specified duration. The schedule targets workloads based on the provided label criteria and can be enabled or disabled as needed.

name.description: Name of the inactive VEN cleanup schedule

inactivity_threshold_in_hours.description: Number of hours of inactivity before VEN is considered for cleanup

enabled.description: Whether this cleanup schedule is enabled
